topic: Poorest countries by GDP per capita

interpretations.label: Nominal GDP per capita
interpretations.description: Gross Domestic Product divided by midyear population, expressed in current US dollars without adjusting for differences in cost of living between countries.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: Nominal GDP in current USD divided by total population (USD per person)
caveats: Highly sensitive to exchange rate fluctuations
Does not reflect local purchasing power or price level differences

interpretations.label: GDP per capita, PPP
interpretations.description: Gross Domestic Product converted to international dollars using purchasing power parity rates, dividing by population, reflecting differences in local price levels.
interpretations.measurableDefinition: GDP based on purchasing power parity divided by total population (Current international dollars per person)
caveats: PPP conversion factors are complex estimates subject to periodic international benchmark revisions
Data quality and statistical capacity vary significantly across low-income economies

preferredSources: International Monetary Fund World Economic Outlook
United Nations National Accounts Main Aggregates Database
knownRisks: Sparse or missing historical economic data for developing and conflict-affected nations prior to the 1980s or 1990s
Inconsistent national accounting standards and informal economy measurement challenges
Country boundary changes and state dissolutions impacting long-term time-series consistency
